President Murmu Confers Padma Awards on 65 Individuals

President Droupadi Murmu presented the Padma Awards to 65 distinguished individuals at Rashtrapati Bhavan. The ceremony recognized achievements across various fields, including arts, sports, and medicine. Notable recipients included actor Mammootty, singer Alka Yagnik, and cricketer Rohit Sharma.
